conviction_note: A small positive lean rather than a call. The FY plan implies a flat H2 (OP 2,443m vs 2,448m last year) while rooms are up 13.5% YoY and storage OP grew 11.6% in H1. The company revised up at the Q3 print in 2021, 2023 and 2024, and the stock has de-rated 18% since the July raise. Against that, it held at 82.4% progress at Q3 2025 and fell 2.3%, and margin longs are crowded at 27.6x. impact_sum (+1.2) is larger than the scaled number (+0.24) because the findings are sized one by one while p_up 54 carries the doubt about the sign.
bar: Company FY2026/12 non-consolidated plan as revised 2026-07-29: sales 28,700m, OP 6,050m, ordinary 5,670m, NI 3,815m, dividend 27.5 yen (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8914&b=n202607300733). No 四季報/IFIS number could be reached (thin coverage: Shared Research only, no estimates), so the street bar is unsourced and every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position at or above 0.5%), no change, as of 2026-10-27 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, in the baseline). 信用倍率 27.58x, a heavily crowded margin long, confirmed on kabutan 2026-10-28 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=8914). No skew exists. Stock at 823-825, near its low for the year, -18% since the 2026-07-29 close of 1,005. The Yahoo board shows retail holders angry at management and fearful of holding through results (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/8914.T/forum, 2026-10-27). priced_lean_pct -0.505 comes mostly from the margin overhang.

findings.finding: The FY plan implies a flat H2 (OP 2,443m vs 2,448m in H2 2025, ordinary +1.1%) after H1 OP rose 19.4% and reached 59.6% of plan. Room count is +13.5% YoY (138,050 at Sep-2026 vs 121,653 at Sep-2025), and Arealink has raised its plan at the Q3 print in 2021, 2023 and 2024 (held in 2025), so a second upward revision, with the dividend raised mechanically under its payout policy as in July, is a live possibility at this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual release dates, prior close to next close: Q2 2026-07-29 with an upward revision and +1 yen dividend: +5.67%. Q3 2024-10-29 with an upward revision: +1.66%. Q3 2025-10-29, plan held at 82.4% ordinary progress (5-year average 78.6%): -2.28%. FY 2026-04-28: -8.05%.
findings.why_not_priced: If a raise were expected, the stock would not have fallen 18% since the last raise to near its low for the year at about 11x PER with a 3.3% yield, and margin holders would not be posting fear of holding through the print. Nobody on the street publishes a number for this name, so no revised estimate sits above the plan. Against this: the H1 land-rights deals were pulled forward from H2 (company commentary), which explains part of the flat H2, and in 2025 the company held at a similar progress rate.
findings.independence: The H1 detail and the pull-forward come from a different document, the FISCO summary of the Q2 短信 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8914&b=n202607300733). The room count comes from the 2026-10-06 月次 (https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261005545713.pdf). The revision history is from kabutan's finance page.

findings.finding: STORAGE-OH (2997) became a consolidated subsidiary on 2026-08-28 after a roughly 2.5bn yen TOB at 1,340 yen, so this Q3 release is the first since Arealink has had a material subsidiary and is likely to carry its first consolidated FY forecast. The mechanical effect is small: STORAGE-OH guides FY1/2027 sales of 4,668m but OP of only 217m, goodwill is about 1.4bn yen (deal value vs PBR 2.34x at market cap 2.5bn), acquisition costs are expensed in the consolidated P&L, and the company itself dates synergies to late FY2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior consolidation switch in this listing's recent history: non-consolidated since 2011 per kabutan. The TOB announcement on 2026-07-08/09 moved the stock +7.7% (804 to 866).
findings.why_not_priced: The deal is public and its size is computable, so the economics are priced. What is not priced is the presentation: a consolidated forecast headline that kabutan will compare against the old non-consolidated plan, with sales up about 1-2bn and profit within about ±2%. Retail reads that headline, and its sign is genuinely uncertain, hence the small size.
findings.independence: STORAGE-OH financials on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2997). Consolidation date per FISCO via moneypost (https://www.moneypost.jp/1438048). The STORAGE-OH delisting date (12-16) is from a board post quoting its notice.

findings.finding: Hello Storage occupancy is still falling: September existing-store occupancy was 86.48% against 89.30% a year earlier, total 78.19%. Own-store openings run behind plan (7,541 own vs 10,046 plan through September), with partner openings over plan (7,564 vs 6,200), which shifts the mix toward lower-revenue partner rooms.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The occupancy decline has been visible in every 月次 through 2025-2026 and the stock still rose on the H1 print (+5.67%).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. It is in the monthly series and probably part of the 18% de-rating. Filed only because the quarter's margin turns on it.

findings.finding: Arealink has said, per a retail board post transcribing Shared Research's summary of the TOB documents, that the ~13,000 rooms acquired let it curb own openings under the FY2027 plan, and that it will consider stronger shareholder returns with the surplus cash. A buyback or return-policy change could therefore come with a results release; the new mid-term plan in February is the more likely venue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No buyback found in the recent record. Dividend raises came with revisions (2026-07-29, +5.67%). A 950k-share secondary offering in Sep-2025 was sold off.
findings.why_not_priced: Holders on the board are explicitly waiting for a capital-policy explanation and treat the price as abandoned by management. A priced buyback would show as support at 820-850, and the stock keeps making lows. The in-window probability is low (perhaps 15%), and the claim is snippet_only (the primary TOB notice has expired from TDnet and kabutan's PDF mirror returned AccessDenied), so it is sized small.
findings.independence: none. Shared Research's page renders by JavaScript and could not be read directly (https://sharedresearch.jp/ja/companies/8914).

outside_window.finding: Synergies from STORAGE-OH (occupancy about 65% vs Arealink's about 80%, unit rent about 70% of Arealink's), which the company dates to late FY2027-early FY2028, and a new mid-term plan / capital policy expected with FY results in February 2027.

Returns: dividend tied to profit (raised with the July revision); a stronger-returns review is snippet-only and more likely in February. New-year guide: no (Q3). Quarter vs own 進捗率: H1 OP 59.6% of plan vs 55.2% at H1 2025; a 9M of about 82-85% would be in line with the 82.4% at which the company held in 2025.

baseline_tension: The lean (+) runs against priced_lean_pct (-0.5, margin overhang) and the -4.3% 20-day run-up; the free control (-run_up) also points mildly up. The strongest positive the release could carry is a second upward revision with an automatic dividend increase (I looked; nothing is pre-filed), and the strongest negative is a held plan read the way Q3 2025 was (-2.3%) with crowded margin longs selling. So p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public 月次 series): occupancy finding moved from -0.3 to -0.1; p_up already near 50, left at 54
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): not triggered; the set leans positive and the strongest negative case is written in baseline_tension
Open question 3 (prior revision kills the event): the July revision covered H1 only, so the Q3 decision is still open; no change
